title: DoctorTux's Special Brew
description: A lightweight modpack with create and other cool mods
body:
A lightweight and performance-friendly modpack built around the powerful Create mod! Perfect for players who want to explore mechanical automation, kinetic contraptions, and elegant factory builds—without the bloat of heavy tech packs.

This modpack includes carefully selected quality-of-life enhancements, decorative mods, and performance optimizations to keep gameplay smooth and immersive. Whether you're automating farms with windmills and belts, building a beautiful steampunk village, or experimenting with rotational force, offering a focused sandbox to unleash your creativity.
